name: Banners help
description: Help mode entries for Molly's Banners plugin (help@1).
author: Brett

entries.title: Banners
entries.text: The Dev Console's live banners, drawn by the console itself. Tap an item to act on it, as in the console; right-click a banner for its Banner settings.

entries.title: Show the banners
entries.text: Shows or hides the whole banner strip at the top of Molly.

entries.title: Each banner
entries.text: Shows or hides one banner inside Molly. The same switch is the banner's “Hide it inside a host app” in its Banner settings.
